entities.summary: Maksym Volodymyrovych Tretyak is a boxer from Ukraine. Tretyak competed at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece and lost in the quarterfinals of the men's bantamweight division to bronze medalist Aghasi Mammadov of Azerbaijan. Maksym Tretyak was a athletes & competitors from Vinnytsia (b. 1984-11-05, Vinnytsia). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
